title: La Dolce Vita
scope: Nuevo dibujo desde el PDF. Las transcripciones y la paginación del pasaje coinciden con la edición previa.

pages.summary: Arianna aprende a aplaudir. Astoria y Scorpius observan el clavado de Draco, que después acepta la carrera de Blaise.

panels.scene: Daphne on a low sunlit rock, long damp golden-blonde hair over one shoulder, opaque turquoise family one-piece, holding Arianna wrapped securely between her legs. Arianna has golden damp curls, blue eyes and opaque turquoise toddler one-piece, her two small palms have just made their first successful clap. Daphne bends to kiss the top of the curls.

Draco waits on the SAME yacht side deck where Blaise stood. He has steel-blue eyes, pale platinum swept hair, slightly sun-pink shoulders and cream opaque swim shorts. That morning's striped shirt, now taken off, is folded on the rail. He looks across the gangway toward his family. Balanced medium shot.

Astoria has dark brown wavy hair, dark defined brows, steel-gray blue eyes, patterned ocher scarf tied behind the head and rust opaque one-piece. She is securely sitting at the low end of the wooden gangway, Scorpius upright on her lap, platinum tuft, blue-gray eyes, light gray swim shorts. Astoria supports his trunk with one arm and gently waves his ONE raised little hand with the other. Both look up toward the yacht, balloon points to Astoria.

Spatial reverse view to reveal that the gangway connects rock to yacht deck: dark-haired Astoria and platinum Scorpius in the foreground, their own relative positions carried over. Draco is on the taller side deck in the distance sending them a kiss with two fingers in front of his lips. Only Astoria speaks. Put the tail of Míralo on the foreground mother, visibly away from Draco.

Draco alone dives from the left yacht deck, two feet high and nearest the left rail, two arms stretched diagonally down RIGHT toward open water and head following his hands. Cream shorts and platinum hair. No rocks or other person in trajectory. Yacht attached gangway farther behind and to the right outside his trajectory.

Astoria stays seated in the exact same place, Scorpius supported on her lap. With gentle hands she guides his little hands through a clap. Both look toward the thin line of foam several meters ahead in the water.

Tight shot of the two adults at the surface, Blaise on LEFT same dark complexion and very short tight black curls, Draco on RIGHT same pale swept-back damp platinum, each visible only once, both smiling. Order of balloons upper-left to Blaise and right to Draco.

Wide waterline view. One Blaise and one Draco have started a freestyle race toward the low pale rocks, Draco visibly just ahead to the right and nearer the target. Natural separate arms and splashes. An anchored dark timber and maritime-navy ketch behind them has two upright masts above deck, sails tied tight, three round brass portholes, short rope gangway to rock, bright calm background. One yacht.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 13 · 65

Arianna aprende a aplaudir. Astoria y Scorpius observan el clavado de Draco, que después acepta la carrera de Blaise.
Astoria: Ahora viene papá.
Astoria: Míralo.
Blaise: ¿Carrera hasta las rocas?
Draco: Cuando quieras.
pages.review: Cotejado con PDF635. Están las cuatro frases y se confirma a Astoria como la voz en las dos de Scorpius. Arianna aplaude bajo el cuidado de Daphne, que no lleva el zafiro de Hermione. Draco salta desde un solo casco hacia agua abierta y gana la delantera. Se preservan caras, tonos, encuadres y bañadores.

pages.summary: Draco gana la carrera. Las bromas se convierten en salpicaduras que también divierten a Arianna y Scorpius, antes de que la familia se turne para seguir nadando.

panels.scene: Close to a single low pale rock, Draco has reached it first and touches it with his open hand while he looks back over his shoulder at Blaise swimming several meters behind him. Draco platinum and pale peach, Blaise dark brown complexion and very short black tight coils. Speech tail points to Draco in foreground.
dialogue: Draco: No recordaba que fueras tan lento.

panels.scene: Both now at the SAME low rock about waist to chest deep. Blaise at left has both forearms resting across the smooth edge and catches his breath. Draco at right laughs at him; only Blaise talks, with one wide legible balloon holding both sentences. Faces natural and recognizable, wet hair.
dialogue: Blaise: Sigo siendo más guapo. Hay que permitir que los demás conserven alguna ventaja.

panels.scene: Draco at right laughs and playfully throws water in Blaise's direction with the single open hand at end of his visible extended arm. Blaise at left smiling and wincing from the arc of droplets. Keep dry coast and one anchored yacht distant. No other foreground figure.

Blaise uses BOTH separate hands to throw a bigger arc of seawater. Some little droplets reach Daphne and Arianna, at right on the low pale smooth rock. Daphne turquoise opaque swimsuit with long blond hair, supports Arianna upright with both arms around her middle; Arianna golden wet hair and simple turquoise baby suit, kicking and laughing. Clear hands and feet, face away from splash.

Repeat established low gangway seat from previous page: Astoria in her rust swimsuit, patterned orange ocher head scarf and waist-length dark waves, smiling. Adult securely supports platinum-haired gray-blue-eyed Scorpius on her lap. Scorpius in light gray opaque swim shorts laughs, his feet near the water. The gangway is intact and solidly attached to the yacht in background.

Draco on right reaches with his only visible left arm to touch Blaise's near shoulder. Blaise on left turned toward the side containing the babies, with a playful surprised look, losing footing into shallow water. Clearly connected realistic adult forearm and open hand over distinct shoulder. Friendly play.

Same two men, Blaise having surfaced laughs and returns a gentle splash. Draco swimming away to the right and stays in the same recognizable cream shorts, Blaise in the navy shorts. Cropped mid-wide so knees and legs remain below the water.

Last wide panel: afternoon advancing, the group in different positions just at the low shoreline. Pansy in black opaque two-piece, angular face, black chin-bob, single gold barrette above her left ear, black sunglasses, thin platinum bracelet at LEFT wrist, bare fingers and ears, seated on low rock with chestnut curly green-eyed Robin in blue yellow-duck shorts securely supported between her legs. Olive-suited chestnut messy-bunned Hermione with her ONE blue sapphire necklace and her one left ring-finger diamond, sits next to her. Daphne in turquoise with little golden curly Arianna still on her own lap. In distance of same frame Astoria sits on wooden gangway and supports platinum Scorpius. One navy two-mast boat with tightly furled beige sails, water and shore. Exactly three different babies, each in one place. Natural reading scale and recognizable faces.
